newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marcos son-in-law injured after falling off horse.
newsitem.headline: Marcos son-in-law injured after falling off horse.

text.p: A son-in-law of late Philippine president Ferdinand Marcos has been taken to a hospital with head injuries after falling off his horse while playing polo, a family doctor said on Wednesday.

Businessman Greggy Araneta, husband of Marcos's daughter Irene, was under close watch in the intensive care unit of the Makati Medical Centre in Manila's financial district "but I don't see any alarm," surgeon Lorenzo Hocson said by telephone.
Hocson said he could not give details about the condition of Araneta until he had talked with the businessman's family.
Araneta's business interests range from real estate to transportation. He is also closely involved in talks between the Marcos family and the government to settle state claims over Marcos assets.

The government has accused the Marcoses of stealing up to $5 billion from the economy during their 20-year rule which ended with the ousting Marcos in a 1986 popular revolt. The Marcoses have denied looting state coffers.
